description: Starts rendering a video and spends its credits (refunded if it fails). Returns at once with an id: poll get_generation until it is completed.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio, e.g. "16:9", "9:16" (vertical, for Reels and TikTok) or "1:1".

idempotency_key.description: Retrying with the same key never creates twice.

image.description: Optional start image: base64 JPEG, PNG or WebP (a data: URL works), under 10 MB.

image_id.description: Optional start image already sent to POST /v1/uploads.

max_credits.description: Refuse instead of spending more than this many credits.

model.description: A model id from list_models, instead of a tier.

photo_consent.description: Required with an image: true only if the person confirmed they have the right to use it and the people in it agree.

prompt.description: What to make, in plain words. @handles use the person's saved characters.

resolution.description: e.g. "720p" or "1080p" for videos, "2K" for images. Defaults to the tier's.

sound.description: Sound on or off, where the model has a switch. Quick always has sound.

tier.description: Quality tier: quick (cheapest), great (best value, default), cinema (most realistic). Or give `model` instead.

name: create_video
title: Create a video
